issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מִי יִתְּנֵנִי' is an optative expression meaning 'Who will give me...?' i.e., 'O that I had...' (a wish). The Vietnamese 'ai sẽ khiến ta gặp' ('who will cause me to meet') changes the meaning from a wish for something to a question about who will cause an encounter, altering the sense of the verse.
